description: Defines the One2MRelationship class representing a one-to-many relationship in SuiteCRM, extending M2MRelationship, with methods for adding and managing relationships, including self-referencing logic.

classes.name: One2MRelationship
classes.description: Represents a table-based one-to-many relationship, with logic for self-referencing relationships and relationship management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the relationship object, determining link definitions and handling self-referencing relationships.

methods.name: linkIsLHS
methods.description: Determines if a link is on the left-hand side of the relationship.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a relationship between two beans, handling self-referencing and clearing existing links.

methods.name: addSelfReferencing
methods.description: No-op override to prevent default self-referencing add logic.

methods.name: removeSelfReferencing
methods.description: No-op override to prevent default self-referencing remove logic.
